desc: 藏青加明黄的学院版面，宽松落肩套头衫自白底主图到收口的七镜漏斗
leaf: 女式横向撞色拼块宽松落肩套头针织衫
name: 学院横向拼块宽松套头衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：纯白无缝底交代宽松落肩版型与衣长，符合平台主图无文字规范
一秒讲清唯一视觉主张：胸前横向拼块形成的色彩分割线，其余版面全部留空
代入真实日常：一杯外带咖啡与街头门口的秋日通勤画面，让买家想象自己穿它
扩展搭配想象：宽檐帽与软皮斜挎包同框平铺，说明这一件可覆盖多种出行场景
消除版型疑虑：后片分割、袖长与圆弧下摆的垂坠在正背面一览无遗
以织纹、拼块接缝与绒面质感替面料参数作证，是全组唯一的品质证据镜
收口促单：品牌色系底衬托单件上衣并留出空白行动条，把人推进详情页选码

style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper-white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with a collegiate navy #1F2A44 flat colour field and a warm ivory #F1EDE6 lifestyle wall; one single matte plane per frame, no gradients, no floor lines, no patterns
style.iconSystem: none: no arrows, callout lines, icons, badges or seals rendered anywhere in frame
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5500K soft studio light, oversized front-left softbox key with a bounce card on the shadow side, a gentle skimming sweep along the fabric to read the relief, one soft contact shadow only, never a hard specular
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium collegiate knitwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper-white #FFFFFF, collegiate navy #1F2A44, warm ivory #F1EDE6 and one bright saffron accent #E8B93A; neutral 5500K soft studio lighting with an oversized front-left key, a gentle skimming texture sweep and one soft contact shadow only; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of frame, no rendered copy, no icons, no badges; relaxed worn silhouette on a generic model with the head cropped above the jaw, stable camera height and slight body turn, consistent knit relief across every shot; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no identifiable faces, no invented fabric or fit claims.
noDrift: no identifiable face or model identity
no invented fabric, weight or fit claims
style.presentationRules: the garment always worn relaxed on a generic model with the head cropped above the jaw, dropped shoulder line falling naturally, identical camera height and slight body turn across all worn shots, back panel shown from a clean rear profile, fabric relief proven by one macro frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm ivory #F1EDE6 fabric surface for flat lays, seamless paper-white #FFFFFF ground for worn shots, nothing glossy
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held out of frame; all in-image copy is stripped and left as empty space for post-production
